## Plugin / version or ownership transfer

- Registry ID and version:
- Public repository, source commit, stable Release and ZIP:
- License and SHA-256:
- Maintainer acknowledgment / proof of repository control:
- Requested permissions and native tools (purpose and provenance):

## Reviewer

- [ ] Automated package and immutability checks pass.
- [ ] Source, license, build provenance and maintainer ownership checked.
- [ ] Permissions and native dependencies reviewed; no plugin code executed by CI.
- [ ] Each version reviewed explicitly; ownership transfers reviewed separately with both parties.

Registry inclusion is not an installation permission grant or a security guarantee.
